ASBESTOS DISCOVERY 503, PETITION OF DEBORAH LARSEN TO PERPETUATE TESTIMONY OF BRUCE KINMAN BY VIDEOTAPED DEPOSITION IS GRANTED. UTILITY TRAILER MANUFACTURING COMPANY'S REQUEST TO LIMIT THE DEPOSITION TO DEFENSE CROSS-EXAMINATION IS DENIED. FRICTION MATERIALS, INC. AND CRA TRAILERS, INC.'S REQUEST TO ADMIT MR. KINMAN'S PRIOR PERSONAL INJURY DEPOSITION TESTIMONY AT TRIAL IN PETITIONER'S FUTURE WRONGFUL DEATH SUIT IS DENIED. MR. KINMAN'S DEPOSITION WILL BE ON JUN-25-2019 AT 9:00 A.M. IN OAKDALE, CA. RESPONDENTS WILL SUBMIT FIVE QUESTIONS TO PETITIONER BY MAY 8, 2019. PETITIONER AND RESPONDENTS TO APPEAR ON MAY 15, 2019 AT 9:30A.M. IN DEPARTMENT 503 IF PARTIES CANNOT AGREE ON THE QUESTIONS. PETITIONER TO GIVE NOTICE. ORDER SIGNED IN CHAMBERS. JUDGE: CYNTHIA MING-MEI LEE, CLERK: A. MOK. NOT REPORTED. (503)
